priority: R_phi fidelity and temporal restoration, separately attributable from H3 LoRA
starting_point: K3 causal FiLM residual CNN family; matched new RGB baseline, not reuse of a historical R_phi checkpoint

data.target: shared original-recording RGB proxy, not pristine GT

output_contract.range_pred: explicitly named clean observation-domain or canonical anchor; never silently interchangeable with sharp RGB
output_contract.rgb_pred: target-resolution fidelity draft supervised against the shared clean RGB proxy
output_contract.uncertainty: local prediction error uncertainty with separate calibration evaluation
output_contract.context: current and past frames only; state reset and chunk equivalence must be tested
output_contract.native_observation: retained as an independent conditioning input, not discarded by the low-resolution anchor

condition_arms: public task/scale condition: controlled non-blind baseline; no oracle severity or physical-operator parameters
observations only plus known output geometry: learned continuous condition, no GT severity or hidden degradation metadata at inference

consistency_contract.default: fixed-strength soft constraint as control; learned action-risk gating is an unimplemented candidate, not implied by prediction-error variance
consistency_contract.hard_projection: only an explicitly validated compatible noiseless known-operator control

stages.work: RGB loader, shared target checks, matched K3 FiLM baseline and clean-input guard
separate range/RGB outputs; observation-derived conditions and calibrated uncertainty ablations
K3 versus causal state, reset/chunking tests and motion/occlusion-aware temporal evaluation
frozen H3 with raw / old R_phi / new R_phi guides and soft consistency toggled; include R_phi-only
train LoRA on the same chosen R_phi conditions; compare matched frozen/adapted H3
mixed and time-varying degradations, new frozen-source evaluation

promotion_rule: Complete matched controls and per-task fidelity, temporal, clean-input and uncertainty reports before claiming gains; small dev results are not omni generalization evidence

implemented_outputs.anchor: derived canonical Q4(rgb); not an independently supervised range head or physical observation operator
implemented_outputs.log_variance: calibration-only head on detached features/errors; separate optimizer

implementation.identity_and_near_clean: generated online with reproducible seeds and explicit separate evaluation controls
limitations: v1 blind observation pre-pooling changes pixel scale between crop training and full-frame evaluation; preserve as prototype, prepare native-scale encoder candidate
v1 training contract omits optimizer hyperparameters; current queue uses identical defaults
v1 comparison needs additional flow-mode/support audit before temporal comparisons

isolated_modules.code/rphi_condition_v2.py: native-pixel feature extraction candidate; CPU tested, not trained or wired into v1
isolated_modules.code/rphi_soft_anchor.py: post-decode canonical/fidelity soft anchor; CPU and synthetic 480p checks passed, not used in pilot/H3
isolated_modules.code/export_rphi_guides.py: full-frame observation-only float32 export with provenance; tiny CPU tests passed, actual pilot output not exported yet
isolated_modules.code/audit_rphi_results.py: strict post-hoc comparison audit; quality requires manual review

implementation.completion_audit: code/audit_rphi_queue_completion.py waits once for finite queue completion; writes audit.json then exits, no notifications or NPU use
